entries.title: Work that asks for something done no longer stops at a quick answer
entries.body: A task that asks for something to be done, such as a review published, a change merged or a merge card shown, now starts as real work instead of as a quick answer. If one still starts as a quick answer, it hands the work back to your first mate, which starts it right away. Before, such a task could show a card saying what it had read, with Look deeper as the only way on. Real work runs on a stronger model, so these tasks use more of your plan's allowance than a quick answer did.
entries.noPicture: This change is in what crewmates, the first mate and the part of the app that sorts new work are told, so no view changes.
